# TradingView

> > TradingView is a comprehensive financial markets platform offering charting tools, broker comparisons, market data, economic indicators, and embeddable widgets for stocks, forex, futures, and cryptocurrencies.

TradingView provides real-time market data and analysis tools for traders and investors worldwide. The platform features broker comparison tools covering FINRA, SEC, CFTC, and NFA regulated brokers, economic indicators for global markets, and customizable widgets for embedding financial data.

## Key Topics

- Broker comparisons and regulatory compliance
- Trading fees and leverage analysis
- Futures trading platforms (NinjaTrader, AMP Futures, Optimus Futures)
- Forex brokers (FOREX.com, OANDA, tastyfx)
- Crypto trading platforms (OKX, Coinbase Advanced, Bitstamp)
- Stock trading brokers (Interactive Brokers, Webull, moomoo)
- Regulatory bodies: FINRA, SEC, CFTC, NFA, FCA, CySEC, ASIC
- Market movers and volatility analysis
- Dividend yield screening
- Economic indicators and country data
- Embeddable widgets and heatmaps
- Multi-asset trading platforms (StoneX, Tradier)
- Order types and trading features
- Market data for NASDAQ and global exchanges
